# QuickCopy Vault

> Save the booking details you type over and over — name, Aadhaar, phone, address, gotram — and copy them with one tap during fast TTD, IRCTC and temple ticket bookings.

QuickCopy Vault is a personal snippet manager built for the booking rush. Users group snippets into categories (TTD, IRCTC, Personal, etc.) and tap a single large button to copy the value to the clipboard. Snippets can be pinned, favorited, duplicated, and exported as JSON.
